prompt: One square richly detailed painterly mythology field-guide illustration of ONE SELKIE in its complete SEAL animal form, never human. Detailed tactile wet skin and stone, entire body in frame. No mermaid tail, human face, clothing, magic horns, wings, accessories, multiple seals, text, labels, border or watermark.
